Third-party software in this package
====================================

mw3launcher.exe uses the libraries below. Each library's own license files,
as its release shipped them, are in licenses\ under the folder the library
came in. Thank you to all of their authors.


SDL 3 (SDL3.dll)
----------------
Simple DirectMedia Layer, https://www.libsdl.org/
Copyright (C) 1997-2026 Sam Lantinga and others. zlib license
(licenses\SDL3-*\LICENSE.txt).


FreeType 2.14.3 (built into mw3launcher.exe)
--------------------------------------------
https://freetype.org/. Portions of this software are copyright (C) The
FreeType Project (www.freetype.org). All rights reserved. Under the FreeType
License (FTL, licenses\freetype-2.14.3\FTL.TXT), https://freetype.org/license.html.
RmlUi's text (below).
Built from its release source (tools\windows\build_deps_ttf.cmd).


Saira Condensed Bold and Medium (assets\launcher)
-------------------------------------------------
The launcher's lettering. Copyright 2016 The Saira Project Authors,
https://github.com/Omnibus-Type/Saira. SIL Open Font License 1.1
(licenses\saira-condensed\OFL.txt). Unchanged, under its reserved name.


miniz's inflate, tinfl (built into mw3launcher.exe)
---------------------------------------------------
Rich Geldreich, RAD Game Tools and Valve Software,
https://github.com/richgel999/miniz. MIT license (licenses\miniz\LICENSE).
It unpacks zip files for the setup kit.

Monocypher 4.0.2 with its optional Ed25519 (built into mw3launcher.exe)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
Loup Vaillant, Michael Savage and Fabio Scotoni, https://monocypher.org.
CC0 or the BSD 2-clause license, either (licenses\monocypher\LICENCE.md).
It checks the signatures of the games catalog and of each release's SHA256SUMS.


libarchive 3.7.9 (built into mw3launcher.exe)
---------------------------------------------
https://www.libarchive.org/. Copyright (c) 2003-2018 Tim Kientzle and
others. Two-clause BSD license (licenses\libarchive-3.7.9\COPYING, which also
names the few source files under other terms). It reads a game's Windows zip
and what a game's files are picked from: zip, 7z, RAR, tar and disc images.

Copyright (c) 2003-2018 <author(s)>
All rights reserved.

modification, are permitted provided that the following conditions
are met:

   notice, this list of conditions and the following disclaimer
   in this position and unchanged.

   notice, this list of conditions and the following disclaimer in the
   documentation and/or other materials provided with the distribution.

DATA, OR PROFITS; OR BUSINESS INTERRUPTION) HOWEVER CAUSED AND ON ANY

(INCLUDING NEGLIGENCE OR OTHERWISE) ARISING IN ANY WAY OUT OF THE USE OF

zlib 1.3.1 (built into mw3launcher.exe)
---------------------------------------
https://zlib.net/. (C) 1995-2022 Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler. zlib
license (licenses\zlib-1.3.1\LICENSE). libarchive's deflate (zip).


liblzma from XZ Utils 5.8.1 (built into mw3launcher.exe)
--------------------------------------------------------
https://tukaani.org/xz/. Lasse Collin and the XZ Utils contributors. liblzma
is under the BSD Zero Clause License, 0BSD (licenses\xz-5.8.1\COPYING.0BSD;
licenses\xz-5.8.1\COPYING says which license covers which part of XZ
Utils: only liblzma is used). libarchive's LZMA and LZMA2 (7z, xz).


Microsoft Visual C++ runtime (msvcp140.dll, vcruntime140*.dll)
---------------------------------------------------------------
Redistributable files of Microsoft Visual Studio, included as its license
allows for programs built with it. Copyright (C) Microsoft Corporation.


RmlUi 6.3 (built into mw3launcher.exe)
--------------------------------------
The launcher's screens, https://github.com/mikke89/RmlUi. MIT license
(licenses\rmlui\LICENSE.txt; the containers it carries, robin_hood
and itlib, also MIT: LICENSE-containers.txt beside it). Its text is drawn
with FreeType 2.14.3 (above).
Copyright (c) 2008-2014 CodePoint Ltd, Shift Technology Ltd, and contributors
Copyright (c) 2019-2026 The RmlUi Team, and contributors


The games
---------
No game is in this package: the launcher downloads each rebuilt game from its
own release, and each game reads your own copy of the original. Each game's
own package lists the libraries it uses. BattleTech and MechWarrior are
trademarks of their owners; this project is not affiliated with or endorsed
by them.
